steps.description: Employee submits expense report through the expense management system within 30 days of incurring the expense.

evidence.quote: Employees must submit expense reports through the expense management system within 30 days of incurring the expense.

steps.description: Employee attaches receipts for all individual expenses exceeding $25.

evidence.quote: Receipts are required for all individual expenses exceeding $25.

steps.description: Finance converts any foreign-currency expenses to USD using the exchange rate on the date of purchase before approval routing begins.

evidence.quote: Expenses incurred in foreign currencies must be converted to USD by Finance using the exchange rate on the date of purchase before the approval routing begins.

steps.description: Route the expense report to the appropriate approver based on total amount.

evidence.quote: Expense reports totaling under $500 are approved by the employee's direct manager within 5 business days. Reports totaling $500 to $5,000 require VP-level approval. Reports exceeding $5,000 require CFO approval.

steps.description: Employee's direct manager approves reports totaling under $500 within 5 business days.

evidence.quote: Expense reports totaling under $500 are approved by the employee's direct manager within 5 business days.

steps.description: VP approves expense reports totaling $500 to $5,000.

evidence.quote: Reports totaling $500 to $5,000 require VP-level approval.

steps.description: Finance processes the reimbursement within 10 business days of final approval.

evidence.quote: Approved expense reports are processed for reimbursement within 10 business days of final approval.
